newsitem.title: USA: General Bearing amends IPO terms.
newsitem.headline: General Bearing amends IPO terms.

text.p: General Bearing Corp has changed the terms of its upcoming initial public offering, according to documents filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday.
General Bearing now plans to offer 1.2 million shares in a price range of $7 to $9 each. It had previously planned to offer 1.0 million shares for $8 to $10 each.
The West Nyack, New York company makes bearing components and bearing products.
Pricing of the deal is tentatively scheduled for Thursday night, for trading on Friday under the symbol "GNRL", according to underwriter HJ Meyers.
